content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fayetteville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years of experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to confirm you meet education and hours requirements before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Our instructor-led course covers the PMBOK® Guide, exam domains, and real-world application—all online, on a schedule that fits working professionals across Fayetteville's military, healthcare, logistics, and government sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After bootcamp completion, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, including proof of education, project experience, and Granite PM Academy's training completion certificate. Pay the examination fee to PMI to activate your exam eligibility and schedule your test date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and study guidance to strengthen your readiness. Sit for the computer-based PMP® exam at a Pearson VUE testing center, and submit your results to PMI for credential verification.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle by pursuing continuing education, project leadership, and professional contributions. Renew your credential on schedule to keep your competitive advantage in Fayetteville's job market.
